intro.story.title: THE OMEGA STRAIN // BRIEFING
intro.story.body:
Year 2147.

The Omega Strain is spreading across eight nearby planets. Normally, the Global Earth Defence League would send a squadron.

Unfortunately, every other pilot is home with the flu, sniffling on the sofa in front of the TV.

Eight worlds. One pilot. No backup.

Autonomous Seeders detected. Containment probability: 12%.
intro.tips.title: GAMEPLAY TIPS & TRICKS
intro.tips.body:
NAVIGATION & OBJECTIVES:
  - The green arrow below the HUD points to the closest Seeder
  - Keep the arrow ahead of you to reach the next target quickly
  - Destroy Seeders fast to stop their infection cascades
  - Watch the infection meter - reaching the limit loses the planet
  - Clear the enemy wave to bring in the MotherShip
intro.weapons.title: WEAPONS & POWERUPS
intro.weapons.body:
COMBAT SYSTEMS:
  - Keyboard 1: Bullet | 2: Decoy | 3: Laser
  - Xbox defaults: [X] Bullet | [Y] Decoy | [B] Laser
  - Select a system, then use your configured FIRE control
  - DECOY is the best way to fight Kamikaze Drones
  - Seeder kills can drop PowerUps - fly into them to collect
  - Some PowerUps permanently improve travel speed
intro.shields.title: SHIELDS & DRONE DEFENCE
intro.shields.body:
DEFENSIVE SYSTEMS:
  - SpaceSwans can drop Shield pickups when destroyed
  - Fly into a Shield pickup to activate it immediately
  - Shield lasts 30 seconds and reduces normal damage to 20%
  - The Shield icon shrinks in the HUD as protection runs out
  - Your ship glows while Shield protection is active
  - DECOY remains the best way to defeat Kamikaze Drones
intro.flight.title: FLIGHT & SURVIVAL
intro.flight.body:
PILOT NOTES:
  - Thrust, steering, fire and Xbox buttons are editable in Settings
  - Flight Settings tune coasting, thrust and gravity response
  - Releasing thrust preserves momentum; plan turns before the target
  - Hard surface impacts damage the ship - control your descent
  - Use Training from the main menu to practise safely
  - ESC opens the menu; on its first page hold [VIEW] 2 seconds to quit
intro.hud.title: READING THE HUD
intro.hud.body:
SHIPBOARD DISPLAY:
  - Minimap: your ship stays centered; blinking marks show threats and pickups
  - POWER is hull health | ALT is altitude | THR is current thrust
  - BIO shows infection progress toward the planet's critical limit
  - Drone and Seeder bars show how much of each enemy wave remains
  - Bright weapon icon = selected; very faint icon = not yet unlocked
  - Speed icon shows your permanent travel upgrade level
  - MotherShip health appears during its battle; FPS/TRI are performance data
training.intro.title: HAL-E ONLINE
training.intro.body:
Welcome pilot.

This training run will walk you through thrust, weapons, powerups and decoy use.

Press ESC on training overlays to continue. Press ESC again outside an overlay to return to the menu.
training.intro.footer: PRESS ANY KEY OR [ESC] TO CONTINUE - [X] SKIPS TRAINING
outro.victory.title: OMEGA STRAIN CONTAINED
outro.victory.body:
Pilot, the Seeders are silent.
Containment probability climbed from 12% to 100%.

The MotherShip is space dust,
the Kamikaze Drones forgot what they were doing,
and even the asteroids missed (barely).

Now wave at the locals - they deserve it.
outro.victory.footer: PAGE 1 / 3 - PRESS ANY KEY TO CONTINUE
outro.simulation.title: THE STRAIN MAY RETURN
outro.simulation.body:
Earth is clean - for now. But the galaxy is big,
and somewhere out there a new strain is already
rehearsing its entrance.

Command has spun up a combat simulator so you can
keep your reflexes sharp and your name on the
leaderboard. Round after round, forever.

Press any key to enter the simulation.
outro.simulation.footer: PAGE 2 / 3 - PRESS ANY KEY TO CONTINUE

briefing.scene1.title: PLANET NEREID - PHASE I
briefing.scene1.body:
Year 2147. Signal received from NEREID. Biological anomaly confirmed: OMEGA STRAIN.

{seeders} Seeders.
Infection limit: {threshold}%. Spread delay: {delay} seconds.

Eliminate Seeders before Critical Mass. Good luck, pilot.
briefing.scene2.title: PLANET TRITON-7 - PHASE II
briefing.scene2.body:
TRITON-7 rainforest colony has gone dark. Omega Strain has breached the perimeter.

{seeders} Seeders, {drones} Drones.
Infection limit: {threshold}%. Spread delay: {delay} seconds.

Sterilize TRITON-7. Leave nothing behind.
briefing.scene3.title: PLANET CYGNUS-9 - PHASE III
briefing.scene3.body:
Dense jungle world CYGNUS-9 is under siege. Omega Strain spreads rapidly through root systems.

{seeders} Seeders, {drones} Drones, {bombers} Bombers.
Infection limit: {threshold}%. Spread delay: {delay} seconds.

Neutralize all threats. Watch the skies and the roots.
briefing.scene4.title: PLANET KEPLER-22b - PHASE IV
briefing.scene4.body:
Frozen KEPLER-22b: Omega Strain has adapted to sub-zero conditions and spreads beneath the ice.

{seeders} Seeders, {drones} Drones, {bombers} Bombers.
Infection limit: {threshold}%. Spread delay: {delay} seconds.

Purge the frozen world. Accept no losses.
briefing.scene5.title: PLANET VERIDIAN - PHASE V
briefing.scene5.body:
VERIDIAN's canopy systems are compromised. Infection cascades through the rainforest roots.

{seeders} Seeders, {drones} Drones, {bombers} Bombers.
Infection limit: {threshold}%. Spread delay: {delay} seconds.

Hunt Seeders before the jungle is lost.
briefing.scene6.title: PLANET ARIDUS - PHASE VI
briefing.scene6.body:
Descending on ARIDUS. Contaminated sand carries Omega Strain across the desert.

{seeders} Seeders, {drones} Drones, {bombers} Bombers, {attackShips} AttackShips.
Infection limit: {threshold}%. Spread delay: {delay} seconds.

Destroy all Seeders before the desert biome collapses.
briefing.scene7.title: PLANET GLACIUS - PHASE VII
briefing.scene7.body:
Entering orbit of GLACIUS amid permanent ice storms. A large war carrier approaches.

{seeders} Seeders, {drones} Drones, {bombers} Bombers, {attackShips} AttackShips.
Infection limit: {threshold}%. Spread delay: {delay} seconds.

Clear all hostiles. The ice planet will not survive another hour.
briefing.scene8.title: PLANET TERRA-IX - FINAL PHASE
briefing.scene8.body:
Final stand on TERRA-IX, origin colony of the outer systems. A large war carrier attacks.

{seeders} Seeders, {drones} Drones, {bombers} Bombers, {attackShips} AttackShips.
Infection limit: {threshold}%. Spread delay: {delay} seconds.

Kill Seeders first; each one destroyed slows infection. There is nowhere left to retreat.
training.prompt.intro.title: HAL-E ONLINE
training.prompt.intro.body: Training is paused while HAL-E explains the next step. Clear the Seeders, collect the PowerUp, then use a Decoy against the Drone.
training.prompt.thrust.title: THRUST AND CONTROL
training.prompt.thrust.body:
Use SPACE or right mouse for thrust.

LEFT and RIGHT turn the ship. UP and DOWN control pitch. Mouse movement can steer too.

The guidance arrow below the HUD points toward the closest seeder or objective. Keep it roughly ahead of you when you navigate.
training.prompt.weapons.title: WEAPONS
training.prompt.weapons.body:
Use RIGHT SHIFT or left mouse to fire.

Approach seeders from the front and line up as straight as you can before firing. The aiming helper works best when your attack angle is clean.

Keep distance after a kill. Exploding objects can throw debris that damages your ship.

Use 1, 2, 3 and 4 to switch systems after you have collected the corresponding PowerUps.
training.prompt.decoy.title: SELECT DECOY
training.prompt.decoy.body: Press 2 to select Decoy. Use RIGHT SHIFT or left mouse to deploy it before the Drone engages. The Decoy draws the Drone away.
training.prompt.powerup.title: POWERUP DETECTED
training.prompt.powerup.body:
A PowerUp has dropped from the seeder.

Fly through it to collect it. In training, this temporarily unlocks the decoy system without changing your real mission progress.
training.prompt.complete.title: TRAINING COMPLETE
training.prompt.complete.body: Training complete. The main mission uses the same systems, but planets grow more aggressive as infection rises.
